The filter needs the project's `site-url`, set under `website` or `book` in `_quarto.yml`.

Links are then written exactly as they are for the website:

```markdown
See the [methods page](methods.qmd) and [the appendix](appendix.html#notes).
```

In HTML they stay relative, because the site resolves them.
In a PDF, a Word file, or a slide deck they become absolute, pointing at the published pages:

```txt
https://example.com/my-site/methods.html
https://example.com/my-site/appendix.html#notes
```

An in-page anchor, an absolute URL, and a link to anything that is not a `.qmd` or `.html` page are all left as written.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-portable-links/>.
